items: Data Orders and Data Bundles are easier to read, with a plain status and real profit after fees
Data order status updates itself from the provider (webhook + automatic checks)
Guest data purchases, Telecel and AirtelTigo bundles, and a service charge setting under Settings → Payments
Sender IDs are screened and approved automatically; only doubtful ones reach your queue
The data provider now shows on Providers, and Pricing has a Data Bundles tab
Data bundle costs use the provider's API price list
